content:
maya(sec): Auditor asked for a minimal evidence bundle mapping our RBAC change process to SOC2/ISO controls, plus KMS rotation/unseal logs and proof of PR-based service-account changes. Can we scope and ETA? @leo @ash

leo(infra): Scope ack. Deliverables: control-mapping (one pager), RBAC PR index with required-approvers, rolebinding diffs + CI smoke logs, KMS metadata (CreateDate, RotationStatus, LastUsed) & event slice for Decrypt/ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey, redaction map, and a GPG-signed attestation for any manual unseals. ETA 36h.

ash(eng): I'll pull PRs touching cluster/rolebindings and add a CI snippet that runs `kubectl auth can-i` checks. Example CI excerpt I'll include:
```
# ci excerpt
kubectl apply -f ci/role-test.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci
```

leo(infra): Splunk query I'll run for KMS events: `index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt*) | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters`. Exports will be redacted (ARNs -> user:####) and we'll include `redaction-map.csv`.

auditor_paul: Please include key policy snapshots and note any policy changes with PR/approval links. Human attestation needed for manual unwraps (ticket id + approver). Redaction under NDA is ok.

maya(sec): I will draft the attestation referencing ticket SEC-2026-999 and sign it with GPG. Note: no key material in bundle.

pkg-bot: pkg: evidence prepackage starting (run id: ev-2851234567-01). Expected files: control-map.md, rbac-prs.csv, role-diffs/, kms-events.json.gz, attestations/attestation.asc, redaction-map.csv, manifest.sha256.

leo(infra): Packaging plan: upload `evidence-2851234567.tar.gz` to s3://audit-evidence/2026-11-22/ with root manifest listing SHA256s and index.csv mapping artifacts to ISO/SOC2 control IDs. I'll post presigned link here when ready.

auditor_paul: ETA 36h works. Please drop presigned link here when ready and I'll start review. Thanks.

maya(sec): Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks; I'll review manifest before upload.
